title: My Jesus, My Saviour,
lyrics_original: Lord there is no one like you,
All of my days, I want to praise
The wonders of Your mighty love.
Let every breath, all that I am
Shout to the Lord, all the earth let us sing,
Power and majesty, praise to the King!
Mountains bow down and the seas will roar,
At the sound of your name!
I sing for joy at the work of your hands,
Forever I'll love you, forever I'll stand
Nothing compares to the promise I have in You.

bible_verses.english: He said: “Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.”
Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name! Praise Yahweh, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits;
For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my shelter, my comfort, and my strength. There is truly no one like You, and I want every breath I take to bring honor to Your name. When I look at Your mighty love, my heart longs to join all creation in shouting Your praise. Help me to rest in Your presence today and live a life that never ceases to worship You. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When life feels overwhelming or uncertain, this beloved anthem gently reminds us where our true refuge lies. Jesus is not just a distant King, but our personal Saviour, comfort, and strength in every season. As we reflect on the wonders of His mighty love, our hearts naturally overflow with gratitude that demands to be voiced. Let this song draw you into a place of wholehearted praise, declaring His majesty alongside all of creation.
